record.rationale: Task6764KT reads actual SFNT/TTC table containers at the browser byte boundary and preserves the defined PhysicalFontFace OS/2 coverage algorithm: original offsets42/78,word-to-bit ordering,optional codepage set and last-successful-word reuse after short reads. WRITER074 records version-zero/partial-read behavior and the uninitialized-first-word boundary, where the browser exposes unknown data rather than emulating C++ uninitialized memory. The core file contains only the extracted capability algorithm; no fake PhysicalFontFace class or service is introduced. Native physical-face ownership,HarfBuzz cmap/collection face selection and dropdown rendering remain unfinished. Collection capability reads require an explicit resolved face index. Actual repository fonts and synthetic binary-boundary cases are checked; advertised coverage is not glyph support.
responsibilities: Actual SFNT/TTC directory offsets,explicit collection index and bounded raw table views.
Unsupported/truncated/duplicate table identities remain unknown rather than fabricating physical metadata.

stackDivergence.rationale: Actual browser-acquired bytes need a container/table boundary before the defined source OS/2 algorithm. Native HarfBuzz face/cmap parsing and backend ownership are not approximated by a native-class facade.
